title: locally presentable (infinity,1)-category
why_consulted: vol1 ch08 §2.1 查过来，要定「可表现」与 1-Cat_Prs 的表述：命题 2.1.2 与引理 2.2.2 依赖可表现 (∞,1)-范畴的极限/余极限封闭性与连续函子的伴随
definition_zh: 可表现 (∞,1)-范畴是「由一个小集合的紧对象在余极限下生成、且自身具全部小余极限」的 (∞,1)-范畴，是模范畴论中可表现范畴在 (∞,1)-语境的直接类比。等价说法有多种，最常用的两条是：(i) 它是可及 (accessible) 且容许全部小 (∞,1)-余极限的 (∞,1)-范畴；(ii) 它恰好是实现为某个 (∞,1)-预层范畴 PSh_∞(K) 的可及嵌入局部化/反射的那些 (∞,1)-范畴。DAG 第 8 章把「可表现 (∞,1)-范畴 + 保持余极限的函子」这一 1-全子范畴记作 1-Cat_Prs：其中的对象是可表现 (∞,1)-范畴，1-态射是连续（即保持余极限）函子；关键性质是它到 1-Cat 的嵌入保持极限，从而图表的余极限与极限仍落在 1-Cat_Prs 中（命题 2.1.2）。
key_points: 可表现 (∞,1)-范畴容许全部小余极限，且由一个小的紧生成元集合在余极限下生成；等价地＝可及 + 容许全部小余极限
等价刻画：可及嵌入到某个 (∞,1)-预层范畴 PSh_∞(K) 的局部化；反射子左正合时给出 (∞,1)-意象
DAG 用 1-Cat_Prs ⊂ 1-Cat 记「可表现 (∞,1)-范畴 + 连续函子」的 1-全子范畴；该嵌入保持极限（见第 1 章引理 2.5.2(b)）
第 8 章命题 2.1.2 把图表的 colim/lim 都算在 1-Cat_Prs 中：colim 由同义反复函子 ins_i 的右伴随刻画，lim 由 ev_i 的左伴随刻画
连续函子有右伴随（伴随函子定理）是 §2.2 中「沿余极限取伴随」全部论证的基础，也是定理 1.1.9 中把 LKE 的存在性化归为可表现性的地方
idea_original: An (∞,1)-category is called locally presentable if it has all small (∞,1)-colimits and its objects are presented under (∞,1)-colimits by a small set of small objects. This is the direct analog in (∞,1)-category theory of the notion of locally presentable category in category theory. There is a wealth of equivalent ways to make precise what this means, which are listed below. Two particularly useful ones are: A locally presentable (∞,1)(\infty,1)-category is an accessible (∞,1)-category that admits all small (∞,1)-colimits. The locally presentable (∞,1)(\infty,1)-categories 𝒞\mathcal{C} are precisely the accessibly embedded localizations/reflections 𝒞↪←PSh ∞(K)\mathcal{C} \stackrel{\overset{}{\leftarrow}}{\hookrightarrow} PSh_\infty(K) of an (∞,1)-category of (∞,1)-presheaves. In particular, if the reflector of this reflection is a left exact (∞,1)-functor, then 𝒞\mathcal{C} is an (∞,1)-topos. See also at locally presentable categories - introduction. Warning on terminology. In Lurie the term presentable (∞,1)(\infty,1)-category is used for what we call a locally presentable (∞,1)(\infty,1)-category here, in order to be in line with the established terminology of locally presentable
